name: Alaric Crowthorne
source_profile:
[p. 15] Oswin is the younger brother of the deposed Earl Alaric Crowthorne. Unlike his brother, Oswin opposed the rebellion. He believed secession would destroy the kingdom and refused to contribute his own household troops to the northern armies. Whether his opposition arose from genuine loyalty to the crown, personal ambition, or longstanding resentment toward his older brother is disputed. Before the war, Oswin swore allegiance to King Dedericus, and entered royal service, providing intelligence about northern fortifications and troop movements. He personally led the forces escorting a cadre of royal officers to Brackenford, which culminated in the Red Steps of Brackenford, an event regarded by most as the inciting incident of the Cadorian civil war. Following the rebellion's defeat and Alaric's disappearance, King Dedericus IV recognized Oswin as the rightful Earl of Greywatch. He now rules from the same ancestral seat that his brother once occupied.
